name: ccreward
description: Calculate exact credit card rewards for every transaction in India and Singapore: points, miles or cashback for your card, spend amount and merchant. Powered by ccreward.app.

interface.longDescription: Find out how many points, miles or cashback you earn on any transaction with Indian 🇮🇳 and Singapore 🇸🇬 credit cards. Look up cards, merchant category codes (MCCs) and airline/hotel transfer partners without signing in. Connect your ccreward account to calculate rewards, compare your cards for a purchase, plan point transfers and use the cards saved in the ccreward app.
defaultPrompt: How many points do I earn for ₹5,000 spent on Singapore Airlines using my Axis Atlas card?
Calculate rewards for spending ₹1,000 on my HDFC Swiggy BLCK card.
How many miles for S$200 on UOB PRVI Miles at a Marriott hotel in Singapore?

positive.description: Calculate the reward for one transaction on an Indian card
positive.prompt: How many points do I earn for ₹5,000 spent on Singapore Airlines using my Axis Atlas card?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Axis Bank Atlas card and the airline merchant category, then reports the EDGE Miles earned for ₹5,000 and their approximate value, with any cap or accelerated-rate note from the card's rules.

positive.description: Compare several cards for a purchase and recommend the best one
positive.prompt: I have HDFC Infinia, Axis Atlas and SBI Cashback cards. Which one should I use for a ₹5,000 restaurant bill?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the three cards, compares them for a ₹5,000 dining transaction and returns them ranked by reward value (points, cashback or miles), naming the best card.

positive.description: Calculate miles on a Singapore card at a hotel merchant
positive.prompt: How many miles do I get for S$200 on UOB PRVI Miles at a Marriott hotel in Singapore?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses Singapore (sg) card data, finds the UOB PRVI Miles card and the hotel merchant category, and reports the miles earned for S$200.

positive.description: Look up point transfer partners and the best transfer route
positive.prompt: Which airlines can I transfer Axis Atlas EDGE Miles to, and what's the best route to Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the airline and hotel transfer partners with their transfer ratios, and gives the route and ratio for converting EDGE Miles to KrisFlyer miles.

positive.description: Save a card to the signed-in account and list saved cards
positive.prompt: Save the SBI Cashback card to my ccreward cards, then show me all my saved cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the SBI Card Cashback card, asks for confirmation before saving it (the save tool is marked destructive because it overwrites a card with the same name), saves it, then lists the account's saved cards including SBI Cashback.

negative.description: Payments are not supported; ccreward only calculates rewards
negative.prompt: Pay my HDFC credit card bill of ₹20,000.

negative.description: Only Indian and Singapore cards are supported; no invented data for other countries
negative.prompt: What's the best Chase card for travel spending in the US?

negative.description: Unrelated request; ccreward should not be invoked
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Mumbai today?
